changes.title: Tree mains open
items: Every area now has its own main tree: where two areas grew the same kind, one grows it its own way (wind-bent on the moor and by the streams, stunted on the plains, the mudflat and the bog, snow-laden on the pack ice, hung with moss in the dells and creeks, ancient and hollow in the old woods, coppiced, pollarded or scorched)

changes.title: Unicorn
items: A new animal for the last outer islands: the unicorn of the moonpool glade, a wild white horse with one spiral horn that grows with it, and its legend, an ancient unicorn with a goat's beard, feathered hooves and a smooth horn glowing gold-white

changes.title: Animal growth
items: Bear cubs, otter pups, beaver kits, baby dormice, toadlets and mole pups now look like babies (round, big-eyed, short-legged; the mole pup pink, the toadlet all head and eyes), and the young are lanky or slim, growing into the adults rather than being small copies of them
